title: The Screams of the Butterfly
overview: The story takes place on an ordinary day in Los Angeles,CA. A man who was a hanging out with his friends makes a choice to drive after a day of heavy drinking. As he pulls out of the driveway of the venue where the guys were at, he smashes the gas and runs down a teenager , who was walking while texting, with no time to get out of the way of the car he is killed on impact. Instead of calling the police , he commits another crime and flees from the scene . Demons from the afterlife appear and revives the dead teenagers soul. They begin to haunt the driver , after a few hours , they try to take the boys spirit to the after life , but he refuses and continues to haunt the driver. After three years of gloom and despair, the driver finally confronts the spirit apologizing , with the spirit finally going to his resting place.
